sloka: रोहि मांसानि च उद्धृत्य पेशी कृत्वा महायशाः ।शकुनाय ददौ रामो रम्ये हरित शाद्वले ॥३-६८-३३॥
transliteration: rohi māṁsāni ca uddhṛtya peśī kṛtvā mahāyaśāḥ ।śakunāya dadau rāmo ramye harita śādvale ॥3-68-33॥

translations.english: Tearing the flesh of the deer to pieces and making them into balls, the celebrated Rama laid it on a lovely, green grassy land as offering to the bird.
